title: 第二百八十四章 兵出险招第二百八十三章 魔音引蛛
slug: 斗罗之张三的逆袭人生
content_zh:
张三立刻明白了她的意图：“您想用这个曲子，把蜘蛛群的仇恨牢牢拉到自己身上，然后带着它们往西跑？”
“这是目前唯一可能奏效的办法。”朱华音的声音很平静，但张三能听出其中蕴含的决心。
“不行！”张三脱口而出，语气激动，“这太危险了！前辈，您很清楚这意味着什么！您会成为整个蜘蛛群唯一的目标！一旦被追上包围……您会被它们生吞活剥的！”
想到那个场景，张三不寒而栗。他绝不能眼睁睁看着朱华音去执行这种近乎自杀的任务。
朱华音再次陷入沉默，手指用力摩挲着笛身上凤纹。她何尝不知道其中的凶险？这几乎是一条死路。
但眼下，似乎没有更好的选择。
“这次事件会如此被动，我是要负首要责任的。”
朱华音神情复杂，眉宇中透着一股悲怆，她吐出一口浊气，放下自己的骄傲和自尊对张三低下头，郑重说道：
“抱歉，张三。当时我没有相信你，所以我未告知冕下你梦中预见的情报，故才让局面如此被动。若是当时我告知冕下，冕下定会有所布置，我们以及蛛网镇的百姓便不会步入如此险境。”
“什么……”
张三愣了一下，心道怪不得朱华音去了洛马城后没有搬来任何救兵，原来当时朱华音就没有相信自己，这可能也是因为当时自己在朱华音心里并没有那么可靠吧。
总之张三并没有因此对朱华音心生责怪之意，毕竟他当时自己都不太相信自己的说法，也不能怨朱华音。
而朱华音则决然道：“所以我必须尽力补救，哪怕是用我的性命……”
就在这时，张三脑中灵光一闪，急忙问道：“前辈，您说的这个曲目，是一定要您亲自用武魂吹奏才有效吗？还是只要让蜘蛛们听到正确的曲调就行？”
朱华音看了他一眼，虽然不解其意，还是回答道：“本质上是音律的效果，与魂力无关，更不需要武魂加持。只要能让它们清晰地听到完整的、特定频率的曲调，就能产生刺激效果。理论上，任何人或方法，只要能重现这个曲调即可。”
“任何人？任何方法？”张三抓住了关键，追问道，“那如果……有人能完美地模仿这个曲调呢？效果是否近似？”
“完美模仿？”朱华音蹙眉，“理论上可以。但这需要极高的音律天赋和精准的掌控力，你是说你能复刻吗？可这曲目难度颇高，我当初也学了半月才学会。而我们已经没有多少时间了，蜘蛛群最快再过半个时辰就能抵达蛛网镇，这点时间你几乎不可能学会，更别提还要在移动中保持吹奏……”
“前辈，请先教我！”张三打断她，语气急切而坚定，“把曲调教给我，哪怕只是最基础的部分！我有一个……特别的方法，或许可以试试！”
朱华音看着张三眼中闪烁的的奇异光彩，心中惊疑不定。她知道张三身上有不少秘密，但此事关乎生死存亡，绝非儿戏。
“张三，此曲虽不复杂，但音律古怪，转折极多，想要短时间记住并准确吹奏，难如登天。你确定要试？”朱华音严肃地问道。

“确定！请前辈赐教！”张三毫不犹豫。
见张三如此坚持，朱华音不再多言。她拿起白银玄凤笛，横在唇边，没有注入魂力，只是纯粹地吹奏出一段诡异而急促的旋律。这旋律时而高亢尖利，时而低沉呜咽，仿佛能直接挑动生灵内心深处的暴戾。
张三全神贯注地倾听，同时手中却握着一金色小球，正是自己很早前在圣心孤儿院时兑换过的“录音仪”，并悄悄打开了录制模式。
吹了几息后朱华音停下，看向张三：“记住了多少？试着哼一下？”
张三没有尝试吹奏或哼唱，只是查看了一下手中金色小球，确认里面的音频状态。
content_en:
Zhang San immediately understood her intention: "You want to use this song to firmly draw the hatred of the spiders to yourself, and then run west with them?"
"This is the only possible way to work at the moment." Zhu Huayin's voice was calm, but Zhang San could hear the determination contained in it.
"No!" Zhang San blurted out with an excited tone, "This is too dangerous! Senior, you know exactly what this means! You will become the only target of the entire spider swarm! Once caught up and surrounded... you will be eaten alive by them!"
Thinking of that scene, Zhang San shuddered. He must not watch Zhu Huayin carry out such a nearly suicidal mission.
Zhu Huayin fell into silence again and rubbed the phoenix pattern on the flute's body with his fingers. How could she not know the danger involved? This is almost a dead end.
But right now, there seems to be no better option.
"This incident will be so passive, and I have to bear the primary responsibility."
Zhu Huayin's expression was complicated, with a trace of sadness in her eyebrows. She exhaled a breath, put aside her pride and self-esteem, lowered her head to Zhang San, and said solemnly:
"I'm sorry, Zhang San. I didn't believe you at the time, so I didn't tell Your Majesty the information you foresaw in your dream, so I made the situation so passive. If I had informed Your Majesty at that time, Your Majesty would have made arrangements, and we and the people of Spider Web Town would not have been in such a dangerous situation."
"What..."
Zhang San was stunned for a moment, thinking that no wonder Zhu Huayin didn't bring in any reinforcements after going to Loma City. It turned out that Zhu Huayin didn't believe in him at that time. This might also be because he was not that reliable in Zhu Huayin's heart at that time.
In short, Zhang San did not blame Zhu Huayin for this. After all, he did not believe his own statement at the time, and he could not blame Zhu Huayin.
Zhu Huayin said decisively: "So I must try my best to remedy the situation, even if it means using my life..."
At this moment, an idea flashed in Zhang San's mind and he asked hurriedly: "Senior, does the piece you mentioned require you to play it with your martial soul to be effective? Or does it just need to be played by the spiders to hear the correct tune?"
Zhu Huayin glanced at him. Although he didn't understand what he meant, he still replied: "Essentially, it is the effect of the rhythm. It has nothing to do with soul power, and it does not require the blessing of a martial soul. As long as they can clearly hear the complete and specific frequency melody, it can produce a stimulating effect. Theoretically, any person or method can reproduce this melody."
"Anyone? Any method?" Zhang San grasped the key and asked, "What if... someone can imitate this tune perfectly? Is the effect similar?"
"Perfect imitation?" Zhu Huayin frowned, "Theoretically, it is possible. But it requires extremely high musical talent and precise control. Do you mean you can copy it? But this piece is quite difficult, and it took me half a month to learn it. And we don't have much time anymore. The spider swarm will arrive at Spider Web Town in half an hour at the fastest. It is almost impossible for you to learn it in this time, let alone keep playing while moving..."
"Senior, please teach me first!" Zhang San interrupted her with an urgent and firm tone, "Teach me the tune, even just the most basic part! I have a... special method, maybe you can try it!"
Zhu Huayin looked at the strange light flashing in Zhang San's eyes, feeling surprised and uncertain. She knew that Zhang San had many secrets, but this matter was a matter of life and death and was no child's play.
"Zhang San, although this piece is not complicated, it has a weird melody and many twists and turns. It is extremely difficult to memorize it and play it accurately in a short time. Are you sure you want to try?" Zhu Huayin asked seriously.
"Sure! Please give me some advice, senior!" Zhang San did not hesitate.
Seeing Zhang San's persistence, Zhu Huayin said no more. She picked up the silver black phoenix flute and held it to her lips. She did not inject soul power into it, but simply played a strange and urgent melody. The melody is sometimes high-pitched and shrill, sometimes low-pitched.Swallowing, seems to be able to directly provoke the violence deep in the heart of a creature.
Zhang San listened with all his concentration, while holding a small golden ball in his hand, which was the "recorder" he had redeemed a long time ago at the Sacred Heart Orphanage, and quietly turned on the recording mode.
After blowing for a few breaths, Zhu Huayin stopped and looked at Zhang San: "How many do you remember? Try humming it?"
Zhang San did not try to play or hum, but just checked the golden ball in his hand to confirm the audio status inside.
